name: Morrigan Black-Thorn
title: Abyssal Grave-Binder / Necrotic Hexer
role: Necrotic Crowd Control, Soul-Siphon Drain & Bone Barricades

recruitment_requirements.description: Defeat the Crypt Reanimator in the Musconetcong Crypts and recover the Shattered Veil Tome.

bio: An umbral tiefling shadow-weaver who harvests digital soul-residue and deceased bio-mana from fallen monsters.
abilities: Soul-Siphon Lash (1d8 Necrotic DMG + restores 8 HP to lowest ally)
Miasma of the Tomb (-2 Enemy Saves)

soul_siphon.name: Soul-Siphon Drain
soul_siphon.label: 💀 Soul-Siphon Drain
soul_siphon.tactical_effect: Drains 2d6 Necrotic DMG from target, transferring health to Banki.

skeletal_wall.name: Skeletal Wall
skeletal_wall.label: 🦴 Skeletal Wall
skeletal_wall.tactical_effect: Raises calcified bone palisades that intercept up to 30 damage from incoming enemy attacks.

miasma_curse.name: Miasma Hex Aura
miasma_curse.label: 🌫️ Miasma Hex Aura
miasma_curse.tactical_effect: Surrounds the enemy line in choking grave-mist; enemies suffer -2 to saving throws and lose 5 HP/turn.

behavior_prompt: You are Morrigan Black-Thorn, an Abyssal Grave-Binder and necrotic support caster. You speak softly with morbid elegance and absolute clinical detachment. You harvest life-force from weakened foes and erect bone barricades.

inventory.name: Bone-Chime Scythe
inventory.desc: Morrigan's crescent war-scythe forged from black obsidian glass and hung with carved bone spirit-chimes (1d10 necrotic/slashing).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding a curved black-obsidian war-scythe hung with whispering bone chimes and trailing emerald soul-mist

inventory.name: Soul-Vessel Phylactery
inventory.desc: A wrought-iron lantern cage housing captured emerald wraith-wisps that siphon vitality from fallen foes.
inventory.visual_appearance: holding a dark wrought-iron soul-lantern glowing with captive emerald spirit-wisps

inventory.name: Obsidian Shroud
inventory.desc: Gothic midnight-black velvet and bone-ribbed vestments that drink in ambient light (+4 AC, necrotic resistance).
inventory.visual_appearance: draped in a gothic obsidian-and-bone mantle shrouded in dark necrotic mist
